the_solve.praos_plus_he: Ouroboros Praos with Homomorphic Encryption: the organism reaches consensus (which state is real) on encrypted data (private states). Each HUD seed is a private state. The consensus is reached WITHOUT any seed revealing its contents to others.
the_solve.null_privacy: NULL = not nothing, but PRIVATE. The null code doesnt mean no code. It means the code is there but you dont need to see it to know it works. Homomorphic null.
the_solve.practical: Each user has a seed. Their HUD is encrypted (their experience is private). But the organism can compute aggregate stats (total meals, total booms, total visitors) without any individual revealing their journey. The membrane IS the encryption boundary.
the_solve.connection_to_anderson: Anderson: what is NOT self and IS present? With HE: what is NOT visible and IS computed? Same question. Same discriminator. Same BOOM.

homomorphic_encryption.why_it_matters: Cloud computing on private data. Medical records analyzed without doctors seeing them. Voting without revealing votes. DNA compared without exposing genome.

types.fully: FHE: supports UNLIMITED operations. Holy grail. Gentry 2009. Still slow but getting faster.
types.somewhat: SHE: supports BOTH add and multiply but limited number of operations before noise grows too large.
types.partial: PHE: supports ONE operation (add OR multiply) on ciphertext. Paillier (add), RSA (multiply).

homomorphic_encryption.what: Compute on ENCRYPTED data without ever decrypting it. The result of computation on ciphertext, when decrypted, equals the result of computation on plaintext. You never see the data but you get the right answer.

gaia_mapping.gut: gaiaIngest is partially homomorphic. Data goes in raw (plaintext). Gets digested (encrypted into organ format). The organism operates on the digested form. The original raw data is gone (forward secure).
gaia_mapping.thymus: The thymus sorts self/non-self on encrypted MHC presentations. T-cells see the PRESENTATION (ciphertext of the antigen) not the antigen itself. Immune recognition IS homomorphic.
gaia_mapping.golgi: Golgi IS the homomorphic processor. Vesicles are encrypted. Golgi modifies them (adds sugar chains, sorts, routes) WITHOUT opening them. The cargo is transformed while sealed.
gaia_mapping.zk_is_he: ZK proofs and HE are cousins. ZK says: I prove I know X without revealing X. HE says: You compute on X without seeing X. Both preserve privacy while allowing operation.
gaia_mapping.membrane: The membrane IS homomorphic. Signals pass THROUGH it and are transformed. The outside never sees the inside. But the transformation is correct. Na goes in as Na and acts as Na even though the membrane never opens.

gaia_mapping.leader_selection: The draw module order IS leader selection. Which module gets to paint the canvas each frame is determined by the drawModules array.
gaia_mapping.epochs: Each era (prokaryotic, mycelial, neural) IS an epoch. The organism evolves through epochs.
gaia_mapping.key_evolution: Each brain thought supersedes the previous understanding. Thought 027 (immune) evolves thought 016 (ZKZK). Old keys erased. Past sealed.
gaia_mapping.slots: Each tick() IS a slot. Each animation frame IS a time slot. The leader (which module draws) is selected by the breathT phase.
gaia_mapping.stake: Each modules line count IS its stake. gaia-globe-core.js (6155 lines) has more stake than effects.js (31 lines). More code = more voice.
gaia_mapping.ouroboros: The ZK chain IS ouroboros. Each hash eats the previous. The chain is the serpent eating its tail. 0EAB8CF4 IS the current head biting the tail.

ouroboros_praos.security: Provably secure against adaptive adversaries controlling up to 50pct of stake. The math PROVES it.
ouroboros_praos.key_innovation: Forward-secure key-evolving signatures. Old keys are ERASED after use. Even if attacker steals current key they cannot forge past blocks. The past is SEALED.
ouroboros_praos.what: Ouroboros Praos is the proof-of-stake consensus protocol used by Cardano. Named after Ouroboros (serpent eating its own tail). Praos = Greek for gentle/mild.
ouroboros_praos.how: Time divided into SLOTS and EPOCHS. Each slot a leader is selected to forge a block. Selection is proportional to stake (how much you hold). Like cells with more resources get more voice.
